tasks.title: Define fault isolation boundaries and atomic persistence contract for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Design RFC 7807 problem details handler, atomic file replacement (temp file write + rename), and payload safety boundaries.
tasks.objective: Prevent crash cascades, partial disk corruption, and unbounded memory consumption.
acceptance_criteria: Atomic storage write pattern (write to tmp + renameSync) specified
RFC 7807 error formatting contract defined for all API failures
Payload size limit barrier (>1MB rejection) established

invariants: State mutations must be atomic and deterministic
Zero unhandled promise rejections allowed to escape error boundaries
